question: What rule governs increases when the base measure is one hand?
premises: The base case is a hand-sized measure
A rule applies to the remaining cases
Increase proceeds by two fingers and one finger
inference: For a hand-sized base, remaining cases increase by two fingers and one finger
uncertainties: Exact parsing of dyavaṅgulāṅgulavardhanāt is uncertain
plain_english: When the measure is one hand, the rule for the rest is increase by two fingers and by one finger.
